place_info.name: Sheraton Grand Pune Bund Garden Hotel
place_info.address: Sheraton Grand Pune Bund Garden Hotel, Raja Bahadur Motilal Rd, Bund Garden, Sangamvadi, Pune, Maharashtra 411001, India
place_info.description: Casual-chic rooms in a palatial lodging with a rooftop pool & eatery, plus a patisserie & a spa.

reviews.author: Ronak Jain
reviews.text: Went there on an invitation for dubai expo regarding investment in real estate property. Had completely new experience. Food was good.

reviews.author: Rohan Sapare
reviews.text: Amazing service. Amazing staff. Amazing steam and spa. Amazing gym and pool. Worth booking. Food is great too

reviews.author: Sumant Kumar
reviews.text: Excellent service, courteous staff, well-appointed rooms.

reviews.author: SHREYASHWINI R
reviews.text: Had a wonderful and very comfortable stay at Sheraton Grand Pune. The hospitality, service and overall ambience were excellent. A special mention to Ritika and Ruchitha, who were extremely warm, friendly and helpful throughout my stay. Their welcoming attitude and attention to detail made the experience even more pleasant. The breakfast was also amazing, with a great variety of options. I would definitely recommend Sheraton Grand Pune to my friends and family and would love to visit again!

reviews.author: jomy jose
reviews.text:
Rakesh is one of the important reasons why I choose the hotel.
His personalized and professional training makes my day.
Thanks rakesh

reviews.author: Ram Agrawal
reviews.text: The best place for conference, corporate presentations and marriage functions.

reviews.author: Rajeev Tripathi
reviews.text: One of the best Hotel in Pune right in heart of the city. The property is very beautiful and very well located. The rooms are spacious and comfortable. Food is amazing and staff is very courteous and always happy to help. Special call-out for Ritika for her very warm welcome

reviews.author: Aashi Gulati
reviews.text: Beautiful premises especially the rooftop. Rooms are spacious and excellent hospitality.
